question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.
sql:
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT city_id 
    FROM city 
    WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
customer_addresses AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM customer c
    JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE a.city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
),
rental_hours AS (
    SELECT r.rental_id, r.inventory_id,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0 as hours
    FROM rental r
    WHERE r.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_addresses)
),
film_category_hours AS (
    SELECT cat.name as category_name, 
           rh.hours as rental_hours
    FROM rental_hours rh
    JOIN inventory i ON rh.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
)
SELECT category_name, SUM(rental_hours) as total_rental_hours
FROM film_category_hours
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1
